note: queen (Queen (Makoto)) — SG / Attacker / Fire / Burst III, cd 40s, ammo 9, hitsPerShot 10, RoF 90 (instant-fire SG), SSR. A distributed-damage Attacker built around the Persona collaboration's '1 More' / 'Follow Up' chain mechanics. The '1 More' status is granted by her burst when a Wind Code enemy is present, so 'when 1 More takes effect' decomposes to burstCast + bossElementGate Wind. The S1 548.99% distributed rider on 1 More IS modeled (burstCast + Wind gate); the Follow Up rider (teammate-granted, no engine source for Follow Up in this kit) and the S2 Baton Pass team ATK buff (35.2% of caster ATK, stacks 3, to B3 Persona allies — no 'Persona state' gate primitive) remain UNMODELED. ⚑ FLAGS: (⚑1) FOLLOW UP TRIGGER — teammate-granted, no engine source; estimate = 0 in v1; recipe = engine primitive for externally-granted status trigger. (⚑2) DISTRIBUTED DAMAGE TIMING — L9 distributedDamagePct 90.01% fires at burstCast (same frame as burst nuke + 1 More rider); engine buff-ordering decides whether it applies to the same-cast nuke. (⚑3) CADENCE TUPLE — RoF 90 / ammo 9 / reloadFrames 111 shipped datamine; SG instant-fire default; est = class-default; recipe = focus video. TIER 2 (bossElementGate status-gate + partial Persona trigger decomposition). Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-18.

skill1: Activates when Follow Up takes effect. Affects all enemies. Deals 548.99% of final ATK as distributed damage.
skill2: Activates when 1 More takes effect. Affects all standard Burst 3 allies (except the skill user) in the Persona state. Baton Pass: ATK ▲ 35.2% of the skill user's ATK continuously. Stacks up to 3 times.
